main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 bars)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and timing gain > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: book timing gain before costs (mean daily)

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the timing gain is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Agitated profile read as regime 'unknown' (the volatility-percentile veto sends the rest to 'chop'), the day's fall as a negative recorded raw value (price return where not recorded); the timing gain is computed before costs as position after the bar's trade x next-bar return minus position x the coin's all-window mean daily return, averaged over coins per day then over days; the slope's t is the OLS t.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0003694 on the check folds against +0.0005295 on every fold
